identity.fantasy: A lightning artillery caster who builds Static and Electrical Charge, marks with Volt, and opens no-depletion Thorim windows from planned stationary phases.
identity.one_line: A lightning artillery caster who builds Static and Electrical Charge, marks with Volt, and opens no-depletion Thorim windows from planned stationary phases. The defining decision is contextual: Mana pressure, interrupts, and movement change when Static should be spent.

mechanics.core_loop: A direct-damage lightning caster that builds Static, marks targets with Volt, and spends on Arm of Thorim, Call Lightning, and Electrocute. Standing still builds Electrical Charge toward a no-depletion window, so it rewards planned turret phases while retaining a lightning dash for repositioning.
mechanics.single_target: Build Static with the lightning kit, preserve mana by spending Static when needed, and align Arm of Thorim with a stationary Electrical Charge window. Current sources describe the builder-spender shape but not a verified exact priority.
mechanics.aoe: Call Lightning, Thunder Wave, and related effects cover packs, but current discussion is more confident about battleground burst than comparative dungeon AoE.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: A lightning dash provides repositioning, but maximum charge explicitly rewards standing still.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Its structural defensive package includes Electrocutioner, Storm Barrier, Ride the Lightning.
mechanics.group_utility: Group or control tools include Arm of Thorim, Volt, Electrifying Aura, Tome of Lightning, Thundershocker.

failure_modes.text: Moving before Electrical Charge matures, being interrupted during hard-cast setup, or overspending mana before Thorim pressure weakens the entire burst window.
Overspending mana before Static can be converted back into resources can end the pressure cycle early.
An interrupt during the hard-cast setup can leave Arm of Thorim available without the prepared charge window.
